title: Event log API endpoints for history retrieval, export, and clearance
description: Implement api/logs_router.py with GET /api/logs, GET /api/logs/export, and DELETE /api/logs to retrieve timestamped application events, export logs to JSON/CSV, and clear entries with confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/logs returns array of recent log entries with pagination/limit support
GET /api/logs/export returns downloadable JSON or CSV file
DELETE /api/logs clears historical log entries and returns success status
Unit tests verify retrieval, export format, and deletion

steps.details: Create APIRouter(prefix='/api/logs', tags=['logs']) with query parameters for limit, offset, and severity filter.
Fetch entries from EventLogger and return JSON list of events sorted newest first.
Provide StreamingResponse / FileResponse for CSV/JSON export; implement DELETE endpoint calling EventLogger.clear_events().
Create tests/test_api_logs.py testing log query, filtering, CSV formatting, and clear route with TestClient.

technicalNotes: Ensure DELETE requires explicit confirmation payload or query parameter.
Do not expose personal data or raw image streams in logs.
